name: diff-viewer
description: Diff pane: what Claude changed this turn and this session, per file, plus git diff on demand

contextLines.title: Context lines
contextLines.description: Unchanged lines shown around each change in a hunk (0-10).

maxChanges.title: Changes kept
maxChanges.description: How many recorded file changes the session keeps; older ones are dropped (5-500).

wrap.title: Wrap long lines
wrap.description: Wrap long diff lines instead of cutting them at the pane edge. w toggles it for the session.
